title: Credit Controller
description:
Position: Credit Controller
Type: Permanent
Location: Bristol
Salary £28 - £30 K plus benefits.
Ref:

HSB Technical is supporting an established financial services business in the recruitment of a Credit Controller. The successful candidate will manage client sales ledgers across a varied portfolio, ensuring debts are collected promptly, records remain accurate and queries are resolved professionally.

Working closely with the Relationship Manager and wider operations team, you will help maintain ledger quality, improve client cash flow and highlight potential risks at an early stage. This role requires strong communication, attention to detail and the confidence to balance excellent customer service with effective debt recovery.

Key responsibilities
- Set up and maintain accurate client files for credit control purposes.
- Manage a portfolio of client accounts and develop a good understanding of each client's business.
- Chase and verify outstanding debts against agreed monthly targets using telephone, email and written correspondence.
- Agree repayment plans where appropriate and with the required management approval.
- Recommend accounts for legal referral where necessary and in line with internal procedures.
- Maintain accurate and comprehensive records of all customer interactions on internal systems.
- Operate an efficient follow-up process, ensuring actions and account notes are clear and up to date.
- Review trading styles and customer information to confirm accuracy and validity.
- Issue statements and collection communications promptly, using email as the preferred method where appropriate.
- Communicate regularly with clients and provide timely updates when issues arise.
- Attend credit control meetings and contribute ideas that improve operational efficiency.
- Complete monthly sales ledger reviews with the Relationship Manager within agreed timescales.
- Ensure client and customer queries are communicated clearly and resolved promptly.

Skills and competencies
- Communication - Professional and confident when dealing with clients, customers and colleagues by telephone, email and face to face.
- Customer focus - Able to provide a responsive service while maintaining appropriate commercial and risk controls.
- Risk awareness - Able to identify potential issues and escalate concerns promptly to the relevant manager.
- Numerical ability - Comfortable reviewing invoices, purchase orders, delivery information and account data.
- Organisation - Able to prioritise a busy workload, maintain accurate records and complete tasks within agreed timescales.
- IT skills - Confident using Microsoft Office and able to learn finance and customer account systems quickly.
- Problem solving - Able to investigate discrepancies, resolve queries and agree practical next steps.

Experience and personal qualities
- Previous experience in credit control, debt collection, accounts receivable or a customer-focused financial role is desirable.
- Experience within invoice finance or a related financial services environment would be advantageous.
- A good standard of English and mathematics, with relevant GCSEs or equivalent qualifications preferred.
- Strong listening skills and the ability to build rapport quickly.
- Good attention to detail and a methodical approach to account management.
- Reliable, professional and calm when handling challenging conversations.
- Able to manage time effectively and work towards call activity, cash collection and debt-turn targets.

Performance expectations
- Maintain debt-turn performance within agreed targets.
- Complete an appropriate level of call and follow-up activity.
- Achieve agreed monthly cash collection targets.
- Complete tasks and ledger reviews within required timescales.
- Deliver excellent customer service while maintaining acceptable risk levels.

Please contact Matt Smith at HSB Technical on (phone number removed) or email (url removed) for further information or to submit your CV.

title: Credit Controller/Finance Assistant
description:
Looking for your next step in finance? Want a varied role where you can take ownership, develop your skills and make a real difference?

We're recruiting a Finance Assistant - Sales Ledger & Credit Control on behalf of a growing, family-owned business based in Bristol.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and expanding business, supporting a close-knit finance team in a varied position combining sales ledger, accounts receivable, credit control and reporting.

Importantly, this isn't just a traditional credit control role. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of customer accounts, build relationships across the business and help improve finance processes as the company continues to grow.

The Role

Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing and raising customer invoices and credit notes.
- Maintaining accurate customer accounts and sales ledger records.
- Allocating customer payments and investigating unallocated cash.
- Reconciling the sales ledger and issuing customer statements.
- Proactively managing outstanding debt and chasing overdue payments.
- Building relationships with customers to resolve invoice queries and payment disputes.
- Negotiating payment plans and escalating problematic accounts where necessary.
- Supporting aged debt reporting, cash collection forecasts and month-end processes.
- Assessing new customer credit applications and assisting with credit limits.
- Working closely with Sales and Customer Operations to resolve issues affecting payment.
- Identifying opportunities to improve existing finance processes, systems and procedures.

You'll be encouraged to work autonomously, take ownership of your responsibilities and contribute ideas to improve the wider finance function.

What We're Looking For

We're keen to speak with individuals who have previous experience in a finance or accounts administration, ideally with exposure to both sales ledger and credit control.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience in sales ledger, accounts receivable and/or credit control.
- Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- Confidence dealing with customers and resolving payment queries.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Experience using Microsoft Office and an ERP/finance system such as Sage, SAP or Dynamics.
- A proactive attitude, with the ability to work independently and take ownership.

Experience across both sales ledger and credit control would be advantageous. However, candidates with a strong background in either area will also be considered if they are keen to develop their wider finance experience.

AAT studies or an interest in pursuing a finance qualification would be beneficial, but isn't essential.

What's On Offer?
- 23 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Private healthcare cash plan.
- Study support
- Death-in-service insurance.
- Free onsite parking.
- Opportunities for further training and development, including AAT.
- The opportunity to join a growing business where you can genuinely influence and improve finance processes.
- A varied position offering exposure to different areas of finance and the wider business.

Interested?

If you're an Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant, Sales Ledger Clerk or Credit Controller looking for a varied next step, we'd love to hear from you.
